summary: Harden the UIXAppTTR repo and branch this month before expanding the SEIS Trusted Marketplace plugin further.
principles: strengthen repo contracts before plugin surface expansion
keep every increment small and reversible
separate local progress, GitHub publication, and live deployment state
preserve unrelated dirty files and user-created work
prefer lightweight validation before heavy builds or live connectors

workstreams.label: Branch Foundation
workstreams.goal: Keep UIXAppTTR synchronized, publish-ready, and protected from accidental main or dirty-tree work.
workstreams.exitGate: branch is on UIXAppTTR, upstream is origin/UIXAppTTR, intended files are committed, and publish readiness is clean

workstreams.label: Capability Contracts
workstreams.goal: Make data engineering, development, design, learning, monitoring, productivity, security, and testing visible as governed repo lanes.
workstreams.exitGate: capability routing is documented, validator-protected, and not dependent on blanket connector activation

workstreams.label: Release And Deploy Readiness
workstreams.goal: Keep release, server handoff, cloud, and upload blockers explicit before any live deployment claim.
workstreams.exitGate: deploy blockers are named separately from source quality and GitHub branch publication

workstreams.label: Plugin Integration
workstreams.goal: Let the SEIS Trusted Marketplace plugin read and explain repo contracts after the branch foundation is stable.
workstreams.exitGate: plugin expansion follows repo contracts and does not introduce unreviewed live activation

sequence: public plugin readiness only after private workflow is stable
stopConditions: worktree has unrelated dirty files that cannot be safely isolated
publish readiness is blocked by source state
live deploy target, auth, or rollback path is unclear
plugin update would require broad connector activation without a concrete task
